review:
Money Maker is a three-reel, single-line slot themed around banknotes. Each reel shows part of a bill, and completing a banknote across the three reels pays its multiplier. Each note has its own colour, character and value, with the top note paying 1,000x.

After any win you can play a heads-or-tails gamble to double it and keep a streak going. BGaming rates it low volatility with a 1,000x maximum and a 97% RTP. It's about as simple as slots get: fast, bright and easy to pick up, ideal for a few quick demo spins.
pros: Excellent 97.00% RTP – among the highest published
Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
